label: Sequence began with o: fires from step 3 through <DEL> (plus weak firing right after s)
explanation: Main component: the sequence opens with o (first_tok=o has 10x lift and carries 59% of activation mass). Given that, the feature fires on every original-phase step from t=3 on and on the <DEL> step. (first_tok==o & phase<2 & t>=3) has 99.6% precision but recalls only 57% of mass. The feature is silent at t=0..2 and nearly silent in the copy phase; its only copy-phase firing is weak, at the first steps that output o. The top activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) all come from sequences opening with a run of o (o o o ...), and they grow over the original phase to peak just before or at <DEL>. When o is the second token instead, activations are weaker (orig(1)==o adds about 18 points of mass). Secondary, weaker component: firing on the step right after an input s (prev_tok=s, 8x lift; b and y show smaller 3-4x lifts that are not in the predicate). These activations are mostly in the bottom quartiles. It does not fire on sequences without an early o or s, and almost never during copying. The disjunction gets dev F1 0.70 and mass recall 0.87. The leftover misses are small activations scattered after b/y and after o later in the sequence.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=s (+16.89), t=2 & prev_tok=s (+13.74), t=2 & prev_tok=y (+11.30), t=2 & prev_tok=b (+10.87), orig0=o (+10.07), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+7.28). Lower it: phase=2 (-14.23), orig0=y (-5.96), orig0=s (-5.50), orig0=b (-5.47).
